title_zh: 免費 6 小時直播：肯定式照顧，支援 LGBTQ+ 來訪者（Kaytee Gillis）
title_en: Free 6-Hour Live Webinar: Affirming, Trauma-Informed Care for Therapists Working with LGBTQ+ Clients (Kaytee Gillis)
summary_zh: eCare Behavioral Health Institute 免費 6 小時直播。2026 年 12 月 11 日美東時間 10:00–17:30 線上舉行（港澳 12 月 11 日 23:00 至 12 月 12 日 06:30），由 Kaytee Gillis 主講，分享點樣用肯定式、創傷知情照顧支援面對少數壓力、家庭拒絕、關係創傷的 LGBTQ+ 來訪者。免費座位不包 CE 學分及錄影，需另購 Premium Pass。
summary_en: A free 6-hour live webinar from eCare Behavioral Health Institute on 11 December 2026, 10:00am-5:30pm Eastern (23:00 Macau time on 11 December to 06:30 on 12 December), led by Kaytee Gillis, LCSW. It covers affirming, trauma-informed care for LGBTQ+ clients navigating relational and identity-based trauma, including minority stress, family rejection, partner harm assessment, and inclusive language and assessment. The free seat does not include CE credits; a Premium Pass adds lifetime recording access and 6 CE credits.
